# Pawsfect pilot role brief — classification pending

**Status:** planning draft only. Do not publish, recruit, interview, screen,
schedule or make an offer from this document.

## Pilot purpose

Prepare a small, owner-authorized pilot with two to three vetted people serving
one approved zone. The working scope is individual-household dog walks and
simple drop-ins. Routine animal transportation, boarding, group or off-leash
walks and medication administration are excluded unless a later, separately
reviewed service policy and insurance confirmation authorize them.

## Draft service responsibilities

- Follow the approved household care plan and dog-handling boundaries.
- Use humane, low-risk handling and stop/escalate when conditions exceed the
  approved plan or the person's competence.
- Confirm arrival, completion and any safety exception through the future
  owner-approved operating channel.
- Protect keys, access instructions, household information and client privacy.
- Follow the approved lost-dog, injury, severe-weather and emergency process.
- Perform only services, times and locations explicitly accepted through the
  future operating process.

## Items the owner must define privately

Before this becomes a posting, the approved role policy must define the lawful
worker model; compensation and reimbursement; scheduling and acceptance rules;
service zone; training and supervision; equipment; insurance; incident
reporting; data access and retention; cancellation; performance review; and
ending the relationship. Those facts—not a title in this draft—must match the
classification review.

## Job-related capability topics

The final, qualified-reviewed posting may describe only capabilities genuinely
needed for the approved duties, such as safe dog handling, reliable
communication, following written care instructions, protecting access
information and reaching approved assignments. Any physical or transportation
requirement must be reviewed for necessity and lawful wording before use.

Do not ask for protected or unrelated information. Do not request health or
genetic history, family or pregnancy information, age beyond a lawful minimum,
religion, national origin, protected-status information, financial history or
credentials unrelated to the approved role. Route accommodation requests and
work-authorization verification through a qualified, consistent process.

## Non-negotiable privacy boundary

No applicant or worker information belongs in this public repository. The
future private system must use least privilege, defined retention, controlled
deletion and a documented response path for access, correction and screening
disputes. GitHub issues and Pages are not recruiting or intake systems.
